findings.title: 1 image served at one size
findings.detail: First: assets/images/wechat-qr.jpg. A phone downloads the desktop file.

findings.title: "知识中心" links to 2 different pages
findings.detail: https://hq10000.com/knowledge, https://hq10000.com/knowledge/singapore-registration-guide. The words on a link are how Google is told what is on the other side, and these say the same thing about pages that are not the same — so the pages compete for it rather than one of them winning.

findings.title: Every page in the sitemap has the same lastmod
findings.detail: All 65 say 2026-09-16. That is a generator stamping build time rather than when each page last changed — which tells a crawler nothing, so it learns to ignore the field.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.detail: The emerging convention for telling AI assistants what a site is and which pages matter.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: The strongest defence against injected scripts.
